description: Enter your current push-up max and get a full 6-week progressive plan with 3 sessions per week.

faqs.a: No — rest at least one day between sessions, and stop if you feel sharp pain. The plan builds volume gradually to stay safe.
Test your true max again (fresh, after a rest day) and use the new number to generate your next 6-week cycle.
faqs.q: What do I do after 6 weeks?

faqs.a: Yes — add 10% to your current max and keep the same structure, or repeat week 6 until you can do 3×15 comfortably.
faqs.q: Can I adapt it for knee push-ups?

howto: Enter the most push-ups you can do in one set with good form.
Follow the 3 weekly sessions (5 sets each, reps based on your max).
Retest your max after week 6 and start a new cycle.
title: Push-Up Progression Planner
